title: Spicy Myeongnan Roe Pudding Bites
description: A unique fusion of Korean and dessert flavors, these Spicy Myeongnan Roe Pudding Bites are a delicate balance of creamy pudding and spicy roe. A perfect snack for adventurous eaters.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together pudding mix, soy sauce, and Korean chili flakes.
In a separate bowl, mix together Myeongnan roe, healing honey, and sesame seeds.
Add the pudding mixture to the roe mixture and stir until well combined.
Add in the butter and mix until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a lined baking dish and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Cut into bite-sized pieces and serve chilled.
